> 1278 天劫（第1页）
林哲羽感觉心神在震动，意识在轰鸣。
无边的恐怖威压从四面八方朝他碾压而来，仿若要碾碎他的灵魂，磨灭他身上沾染的所有终末浩劫气息。
林哲羽此刻还在进行着某种特殊的深层次共鸣，源源不断的玄妙感悟涌入他的心神，千丝万缕最终汇聚成一股浩瀚的洪流。
景安帝其实有些个犹豫，要不要让江宁织造局出人，他倒不是在乎那三成干股，是有些担心景凤仪摊子铺得太大，最后收拾不住，直接瘫了。
此时黑色云海像是拨开了厚重的阴霾，翻涌着刺眼的金光，光耀而夺目。
陆淮靠在椅背上，下颚的线条凌厉分明，手指轻按着眉心。方才那个电话是疗养院打来的，过几日便是他妹妹的生日。
“反正得一块儿送粮税呢。”章颜温声劝着，章颜是很希望秦凤仪能与陛下缓和一下父子关系的，故而，颇多劝慰之处。
“谢谢你的关心，我儿子要去从军了，帮他打点打点行李。”王好微笑说道。
底下流民齐齐看向城头，他们希望这在前面奋战，超强实力的男人，可以改变城里的决定，让他们进城。
一袭儒雅常服的帝王从帷幕后走出，鬓若刀裁，疏朗清峻，口吻中透着对长辈的关怀与厚待。谁也没想到，在前一刻，他是怎样丧心病狂威胁自己的老师。
也许一年两年，嘉成帝并不会对其改观，可若是三年四年，一如既往呢？
“你做得对。”严大姐道，“兵无常势，水无常形。他们既有自己的法子，只要能杀人，能战斗，这便没什么不好的。”见这些土人虽则个子黑矮，但训练的很卖力，严大姐对于秦凤仪治兵心里便有数了。
秦凤仪真不想对景安帝低头，只是一想到战事中遭秧的百姓，也便顾不得许多了。
水无心面色严肃，感觉香肩上的负担有点沉甸甸的，明白这一战事关九剑宫的荣誉，要是她败给了林月银，也代表着九剑宫单人对决不如七绝派，因而她必须得全力以赴战胜她才行，才能考虑之后团战的事情。
韩明成不由一阵头疼苦涩，他本来想要通过白阳抱上阴阳门这棵大树，保证大韩王朝的昌盛，并且成全了韩灵茉的心意，达到两全其美的地步。没想到对他怀有情愫的人居然有好几个，而且还很强势，丝毫不让。
“芽儿，口感如何？”凤于飞毫不在意的摆摆手，然后对着芽儿笑道。
只是他没告诉大黄的是，饿了十几天，他哪里有气力逃出两三里路，还是雪路？
方婷萱的目光，随着医生翻看病历的动作变得有些闪躲，她甚至有想要逃跑的冲动。

刚和芽儿笑嘻嘻的走到府门，便看见一袭月白长袍的上官弘烈靠在门框上，似是专程等她们回来。
不过，好像只是换了岳父大人的成全还有些不够，还需要点别的什么来弥补。
“有的，有时候会来公司找我，约我去看电影，其它同事不知道这个事情，我也不想让他们知道，他们知道了肯定会说我的八卦。”她不是卢总，没有那么强大的心脏，由着他们说，她希望她的爱情多一些美好。
说到这里，凤苏颜不由有些娇羞，自己怎么会不知轻重地说出这番话来？这样说的话岂不是表示自己是他的妻子人选之一？

The latest chapter of Martial Arts Immortal_1278 Heavenly Tribulation Page 1_Martial Arts Immortal Mo Yiguan_Hot Novel Network
> 1278 Heavenly Tribulation (Page 1)
Lin Zheyu felt his heart shaking and his consciousness roaring.
The boundless terrifying pressure was crushing towards him from all directions, as if to crush his soul and wipe out all the aura of doomsday catastrophe on his body.
Lin Zheyu was still experiencing some kind of special deep resonance at this moment, and a steady stream of mysterious insights poured into his mind, and thousands of threads finally converged into a vast torrent.
Emperor Jing'an was actually a little hesitant about whether to let Jiangning Weaving Bureau hire someone else. He didn't care about the 30% of the shares, but he was a little worried that Jing Fengyi's stall was too big and he couldn't handle it in the end and collapsed.
At this time, the black sea of ​​clouds seemed to have parted from the heavy haze, and a dazzling golden light surged, dazzling and dazzling.
Lu Huai leaned on the back of the chair, his jaw line was sharp and clear, and his fingers lightly pressed between his eyebrows. The call just now was from the nursing home, and it was his sister's birthday in a few days.
"Anyway, we have to pay the grain tax together." Zhang Yan persuaded in a gentle voice. Zhang Yan really hoped that Qin Fengyi could ease the father-son relationship with His Majesty, so there was a lot of comfort.
"Thank you for your concern. My son is going to join the army. Please help him pack his luggage." Wang Hao said with a smile.
The refugees below all looked towards the top of the city. They hoped that this man with super strength who was fighting in front could change the city's decision and let them enter the city.
The emperor, dressed in elegant uniforms, walked out from behind the curtain. His temples were as sharp as a knife, and he was clear and solemn. His tone revealed his care and kindness to his elders. No one could have imagined how frantically he threatened his teacher just a moment ago.
Maybe Emperor Jiacheng wouldn't change his mind in one or two years, but what if it stays the same in three or four years?
"You are right." Sister Yan said, "Soldiers are unpredictable, and water is unpredictable. Since they have their own methods, as long as they can kill people and fight, there is nothing wrong with it." Seeing that although these natives were dark and short, they trained very hard, Sister Yan knew how Qin Fengyi managed the army.
Qin Fengyi really didn't want to bow to Emperor Jing'an, but when she thought of the people who suffered in the war, she couldn't care less.
Shui Wuxin looked serious, feeling that the burden on Xiang's shoulders was a bit heavy. She understood that this battle was related to the honor of Jiujian Palace. If she lost to Lin Yueyin, it also meant that the Nine Swords Palace was not as good as the Qijue Faction in a single battle, so she had to go all out to defeat her before she could consider the subsequent team battle.
Han Mingcheng couldn't help but feel a headache. He originally wanted to use Bai Yang to hug the big tree of Yin Yang Gate to ensure the prosperity of the Korean Dynasty and fulfill Han Lingmo's wish, achieving the best of both worlds. Unexpectedly, there are actually several people who have feelings for him, and they are very strong and will not give in at all.
"Ya'er, how does it taste?" Feng Yufei waved his hand nonchalantly, then smiled at Ya'er.
But what he didn't tell Dahuang was that after being hungry for more than ten days, how could he have the energy to escape two or three miles, or even the snowy road?
Fang Tingxuan's eyes became a little dodgey as the doctor looked through the medical records, and she even had the urge to run away.
As soon as they and Ya'er walked to the door of the mansion with smiles on their faces, they saw Shangguan Honglie in a moon-white robe leaning against the door frame, as if he was waiting for them to come back.
However, it seems that just being fulfilled by my father-in-law is not enough, and something else is needed to make up for it.
"Yes, sometimes they come to the company to find me and invite me to watch movies. Other colleagues don't know about this, and I don't want them to know. If they know, they will definitely gossip about me." She is not Mr. Lu, and she does not have such a strong heart. Let them talk, and she hopes that her love will be more beautiful.
Speaking of this, Feng Suyan couldn't help but feel a little shy. How could she say these words without knowing the importance of it? If you say this, doesn't it mean that you are his?One of the candidates for wife?
